result.title: StructZO: Structured Zeroth-Order Optimization for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
result.summary: Fine-tuning large language models at scale is increasingly limited by the memory cost of backpropagation. Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimizers reduce this burden by relying only on forward function evaluations, but they still exhibit a substantial performance gap to first-order (FO) optimizers such as Adam. We argue that this gap does not arise solely from the absence of explicit gradients: FO fine-tuning also benefits from informative low-rank optimization geometry, large-scale signal aggregation, and well-conditioned update directions. Motivated by this, we introduce StructZO, a structured Zeroth-Order optimization framework for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning. StructZO performs large-query ZO estimation within an activation-induced informative subspace and applies spectral control to the resulting reduced-space update before mapping it back to the original parameters. This lets ZO aggregate useful directional signals in a compact, geometry-aware space while avoiding the activation and optimizer-state memory costs of backpropagation. We show theoretically that, when the induced subspace captures concentrated optimization-relevant directions, StructZO reduces the effective ZO estimation dimension from $mn$ to $mr$, with the remaining projection error governed by the spectral tail of the activation Gram matrix. Empirically, across OPT-series and Llama3.1-8B on diverse downstreamtasks, StructZO improves over the strongest existing ZO baselines by up to $8.7%$ relative on average and up to $26.9%$ relative on individual tasks, while remaining within $1.5%$ of FO-Adam on average. These results suggest that structured and spectrally controlled ZO updates can substantially narrow the gap between ZO and FO optimization.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 StructZO，一种结构化零阶优化框架：在激活诱导的低维子空间内做大规模查询估计，对子空间更新做谱控制后再映射回原参数，从而在省去反向传播激活与优化器状态内存的同时提升 LLM 微调效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「激活诱导信息子空间＋谱控制」的用法或可供核查：类似手段可用于识别内部状态中与任务相关的少数方向、度量 latent 表示的低秩结构与投影损失，但它面向纯文本微调效率，与视觉推理状态生成无直接关系，迁移属推测。
